correctness.rationale: On the specified categorical product, adjacent column masks are compatible iff one is empty or both are the same singleton; this gives a second exhaustive face enumerator including the wrap-around. The independent replay gives 216257 faces, 108121 pairs, a topological ordering of all faces over 1502070 covers, critical counts (1,8,6) in dimensions (0,5,6), and the identical integer Morse boundary by forward signed path propagation. Its six active rows sum to zero and the exhibited 5x5 minor is +1, so rank 5 with all nonzero Smith factors units. The Morse CW complex is the cofiber of a map from six to eight 5-spheres; by Hurewicz the integer attaching vectors determine the map, and unimodular basis changes are realized by wedge self-equivalences. The five identity cofibers are contractible and the remaining attachments are zero, proving the ordinary wedge. This is not a uniform cycle-product result.
